criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain broad soft annulated body, gill flaps above stout legs, six cephalic spines and paired short posterior lobes. Concept wrongly makes oral cone a large forward horn: put a shallow ventral cone underneath head, with plate-like rim cues. No eyes. Appendages remain flexible, no rigid elbows, spines slender rather than crab claws.

Thick soft annulated cigar-shaped trunk with eleven paired broad gill flaps above eleven paired short stout lobopods. Paired flexible annulated frontal appendages with inward spines and three elongate distal tips each; six short cephalic spines in two groups of three. Blunt posterior with two short posterior lobes, no Kerygmachela-like long tail; ventral restrained oral cone between appendage bases, not a protruding nose. Whole body reference gate resolved prospectively from Young and Vinther2017 original specimens and explicitly schematic Fig11. Not inferred from oral cone alone.
